caption: The one call fareLabel(km: 8): because 8 ≤ 10 is true, the rate is 9.0 and the fare is 20 + 8 × 9.0 = 92.0, so the function returns the string Short trip: ₹92.0. The grey path is the rate 11.5 that a 12 km call would take instead.

spec.title: One call of fareLabel(km: 8)
spec.aria: Flowchart of the call fareLabel with km = 8: the test 8 ≤ 10 is true, so rate = 9.0, fare = 20 + 8 × 9.0 = 92.0, and the function returns the string Short trip: ₹92.0; the false branch would set rate = 11.5.
